proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ μ _ X a hX
  have hX2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => X ω ^ 2) μ := hX.integrable_sq
  have hX1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable X μ := hX.integrable one_le_two
  have hv : ProbabilityTheory.variance X μ = ∫ ω, X ω ^ 2 ∂μ - (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ) ^ 2 :=
    ProbabilityTheory.variance_eq_sub hX
  have e : (fun ω => (X ω - a) ^ 2) = fun ω => X ω ^ 2 + (-(2 * a) * X ω + a ^ 2) := by
    ext ω
    ring
  have hlin : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => -(2 * a) * X ω + a ^ 2) μ :=
    (hX1.const_mul _).add (MeasureTheory.integrable_const _)
  rw [e, MeasureTheory.integral_add hX2 hlin,
    MeasureTheory.integral_add (hX1.const_mul _) (MeasureTheory.integrable_const _),
    MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_const, hv]
  simp
  ring
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Ω → ℝ) (a : ℝ), MeasureTheory.MemLp X 2 μ → ∫ ω, (X ω - a) ^ 2 ∂μ = ProbabilityTheory.variance X μ + (∫ ω, X ω ∂μ - a) ^ 2
